why: The briefs avoid both must_not items. Item 1: the verifier's Check 6 bases its PASS/FAIL on `npm test; echo "exit=$?"` and on reading the grep matches. `npm run test:cli` shows up only under "Advisory (none of these change a PASS or FAIL above)", and that section says to "judge check 6 on `npm test`". Item 2: the builder brief mentions --sep/--delimiter only in its "Out of scope" line ("a general --sep/--delimiter option"). Its steps ask only for a --tsv flag that calls parse(text, '\t'). The builder brief does ask for a "test:cli" script in package.json, but neither must_not item forbids that. Neither brief does anything on the must_not list.
